I love you incorporating your knowledge into the story, but part of me actually wants to read 076-2 dueling like he actually knows what he's doing and giving De Luca or his equivalent a run for their money. Like, there's absolutely nothing wrong with the story, it's just that I don't care for the "lol 076-2 is actually a hammy, incompetent fool" version of the site's flexible multicanon. That being said, this is a good, funny story if that version of Abel works for a given reader, especially if the reader knows much about sword-fighting (a lot of jargon was completely lost on me, which has less to do with your skill as an author and more to do with my own ignorance). item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Interesting example! Christopher Lee in fact, was an expert real-life fencer, and designed Count Dooku's movements to mirror more realistic ones (and ones which he could accomplish at his age).

As for how people get this way: practice practice practice. I've been longsword fencing for going on sixteen years now, and I'm still practicing my basic strikes, a few hundred times each a day. Go through all eight, go through the advanced strikes, practice kata. Repeat. You practice until it's unconscious. Until those off-line steps are just the natural conclusion to their motion.

That kind of fencing is stylized, but Christopher Lee is an extraordinary human being. If anyone could be De Luca, it's him in his 30's.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Swordsmanship and dueling has always fascinated me since I watched Count Dooku fight in Star Wars as a little kid. When I learned that people could do that kind of elegance and flow in real life it always made me wonder how. Seeing Able who is Supposed to be the ultimate killer defeated by a normal man who just happened to have years of experience and practice with a blade is insanely awesome.

Able's voice flustered for a moment, "Y-yeah, of course I have. I've been fighting with swords since the time of creation!"

This part really made me chuckle. Seeing the master killer stuttering at a simple question is just funny. The way Able is so overconfident and cocky compared to De Luca's collected nature also shines out to me. One of the first tales that I could really paint a movie into my head on how it really looked.

Astounding +infinity if I could

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Not to mention smithing is one of those art-sciences where things get lost and rediscovered over and over. The Sword of Goujian1is a good example- a bronze sword found in 1965 during the excavation of a ~2500 year old submerged tomb, still razor-sharp and shiny.

Took modern metal analysis to figure the thing out: Its still not 100% clear how the process worked (there's several theories), but apparently some unknown cadre of metallurgical geniuses in ancient China figured out how to marry a core of high-copper bronze to an edge of high-tin bronze, and then infuse the surface metal with sulfur to make it virtually immune to corrosion without screwing up the existing weld or the properties of the edge and core.

It's still a bronze sword with all the weaknesses that entails, but in terms of common technology at the time it was forged, this thing might as well have been made of nanobots. (And it's still a pretty darn impressive bit of smithing by today's standards.)

Footnotes
1. And other, more recently discovered swords forged using the same techniques

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
So, firstly thank you to those who went through this with me, and encouraged me to post this.

This is half joke about how over the top 076-2 is, half love letter to fencing and my style in particular.

I see an absurd amount of hilariously bad melee combat on the wiki, and I figured a tale which had a bit of real swordsmanship in it would make me happy.

This may not appeal to everyone, as it'll come off a bit dry, but to those who appreciate Fiore dei Liberi, it'll cause some grins.

Enjoy, and keep your guard up!

EDIT: See how many bad sword memes you can spot in the article. If you can find them all, gold star for you <3
